title: Physiology and Cell Biology
description: An introductory course in the biological sciences. Biological chemistry, cellular diversity, membrane structure and function, energy transduction, DNA replication. Structure, growth, nutrition, and development of plants; principles of animal physiology including homeostatic mechanisms, circulation, gas exchange, osmoregulation, thermoregulation, defense systems, chemical signalling, reproduction and development.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of BIOL 186, BIOL 190A.
BIOL 184 and BIOL 186 may be taken in any order. Students who have passed a placement exam may request permission to register in the course.
recommendations: One of Chemistry 11, Chemistry 12, CHEM 091, CHEM 101, CHEM 102, CHEM 150 recommended prior to BIOL 186.
